title: Knee Arthroscopy with Meniscectomy

required_documentation.description: Documentation of a conservative treatment trial (PT, NSAIDs, activity modification, and/or injection) prior to surgery, unless locking/instability is present.
Imaging (typically MRI) confirming a meniscal tear or other structural abnormality consistent with the requested procedure.

criteria: Imaging (MRI preferred) confirms a meniscal tear or structural abnormality consistent with the patient's symptoms.

A conservative treatment trial (physical therapy, NSAIDs, activity modification, and/or corticosteroid injection) of at least 4-6 weeks has been attempted and failed, OR mechanical locking/instability is documented.
Symptoms (pain, swelling, mechanical locking, or instability) are significant enough to functionally limit the patient.
No absolute surgical contraindication documented in the record.
notes: Synthetic policy created for this demo; not an actual InterQual criterion.
